named_agent_tool_run_the_agent_as_a_suba: Run the `{agent_id}` agent as a subagent. Provide one or more task strings; the agent loads its own persona and selected tool surface.
named_agent_tool_one_or_more_clear_detai: One or more clear, detailed task prompts to run in parallel.
task_params_one_or_more_clear_detailed_t: One or more clear, detailed task prompts to run in parallel.
task_params_worker_agent_id_loads_that_a: Worker agent id; loads that agent's persona and selected tools.
task_params_optional_session_id_for_a_wo: Optional session id for a worker context.
task_params_return_a_handle_at_once_and: Return a handle at once and run the workers in the background.
task_params_run_starts_workers_poll_wait: run starts workers; poll, wait and kill act on a background handle.
task_params_background_task_id_from_a_ha: Background task id from a HANDLE line, for poll/wait/kill.
task_params_seconds_a_wait_blocks_withou: Seconds a wait blocks; without it, wait blocks until the task ends.
task_params_model_for_the_subagent_s_sam: Model for the subagent(s), same string as --model. Set it when the operator names one; omit otherwise.
tools_plan_name_used_in_the_filename: Plan name used in the filename.
tools_version_suffix_used_in_the_filenam: Version suffix used in the filename.
tools_replace_an_existing_plan_with_the: Replace an existing plan with the same name and version.
named_agent_tool_reasoning: Reasoning effort for the subagent(s): minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Set it when the operator names one; omit otherwise.
